spec.title: Incoming Requests by Destination and Response Code

spec.expr: round(sum(rate(hubble_http_requests_total{cluster=~"${cluster}", destination_namespace=~"${destination_namespace}", destination_workload=~"${destination_workload}", reporter="${reporter}", source_namespace=~"${source_namespace}", source_workload=~"${source_workload}"}[$__rate_interval])) by (cluster, destination_namespace, destination_workload, status), 0.001)
